risks.title: Macroeconomic Risk
risks.summary: Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions can have a significant negative impact on demand and profitability
risks.score_rationale: Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions, geopolitical tensions, inflation, slowing growth, currency fluctuations, and rising tariffs can negatively impact customer confidence, spending, and demand for the company's products and services.

risks.title: Price Volatility and Cost Inflation
risks.summary: Volatility in raw material prices and input cost inflation affect profitability
risks.score_rationale: Volatility in raw material prices, supply chain disruptions, and pricing pressures can impact profitability. The company uses dual sourcing strategies and long-term agreements to mitigate these risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Technological Transformation
risks.summary: Cyber risks increase with investments in digital technologies and artificial intelligence
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity incidents can have a significant impact on the company. Growing investments in digital technologies and AI expose the company to additional cyber risks.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition can affect sales and profitability, particularly regarding technology adoption
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the company's markets can be intense. There is a risk that competitors may adopt emerging technologies such as AI faster and more successfully than ITT.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.summary: Financial difficulties of customers and suppliers can affect collections and profitability
risks.score_rationale: Financial difficulties of customers and suppliers may impact the company's ability to collect receivables and maintain business relationships. Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions increase this risk.

risks.title: Skilled Labor Shortage
risks.summary: Tight labor markets and specialized skill requirements affect operational capacity
risks.score_rationale: A shortage of skilled labor may impact the company's ability to maintain operations, delivery quality, and innovation. ITT addresses this risk through talent programs and selective automation.

risks.title: Regulatory and Commercial Compliance Risk
risks.summary: Changes in tariffs, trade policies, and regulations affect operations and costs
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations, tariffs, and trade policies can impact operations and profitability. ITT must ensure compliance with agreements such as USMCA to maintain access to North American markets.

ai_positioning.summary: ITT mentions artificial intelligence as a key element of technological transformation affecting the manufacturing industry. The company views AI as an opportunity to improve efficiency and reliability, but also recognizes associated cybersecurity risks and the possibility that competitors may adopt the technology more quickly.
evidence: Technology Transformation: Accelerating advancements in automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence continue to reshape manufacturing and industrial solutions.
